battle.name: 科爾基斯征服迪亞烏希
battle.theater: 厄維亞島西南岸迪亞烏希
battle.brief: 公元前757年，科爾基斯（科孚島）與母邦科林斯為厄維亞島西南岸的迪亞烏希開戰。科林斯派兵援救自己的殖民地，科爾基斯攻下城邑，把成年男子賣為奴隸，其餘城地獻予阿波羅。卡面這柄兩米長的斯巴達長矛，正是荷馬式重裝步兵手中的標準長兵器。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭是科爾基斯（科孚島）與母邦科林斯之間的一次殖民權力對決，交會地點在厄維亞島西南岸的迪亞烏希。科爾基斯本身是科林斯在八世紀初建立的殖民地，但到公元前757年前後，它已經是一個獨立的島上城邦：由赫拉克勒斯後裔的世襲家族執政，靠扼守希臘本土通往義大利與西西里的海路、以及島上土地與洛基海盆的物產，人口與實力都足以單獨作戰；後世的希臘人仍把科爾基斯算作最古老、最富庶的殖民地之一。科林斯一方由科林斯城邦本身出兵，執政的是巴奇亞德家族，一個兼掌城政與德爾斐阿波羅祭司之職的世襲貴族；巴奇亞德家族同時是科林斯對外殖民的推手，迪亞烏希被科林斯視為自己在厄維亞島的據點，母邦有義務保護殖民地。迪亞烏希原是卡爾基斯或埃雷特里亞一系在島上的早期居地，後來才落到科林斯手中，因此這座城同時捲入島上兩個母邦的角力。第三方是斯巴達：科林斯的巴奇亞德與斯巴達的亞基亞德同出多利安人、同為赫拉克勒斯後裔，後世流傳科林斯曾就此事向斯巴達求援，斯巴達是否出兵、派了多少人，已無可靠記載。作戰雙方都沒有留下可考的指揮官姓名，決策由各自城邦的議會與執政家族作出，作戰主力則是從公民中徵發的重裝步兵，輔以快速帆船與五十槳長船。
countriesEn: This war was a colonial power struggle between Corcyra (the island of Corfu) and its mother city Corinth, fought over Dyme on the south-west coast of Euboea. Corcyra itself was a colony founded by Corinth in the early eighth century BC, but by the time of 757 BC it had become an independent island polis: it was ruled by a hereditary house descended from Heracles, and it drew its wealth from commanding the sea lane between the Greek mainland and Italy and Sicily, as well as from the island's own land and the produce of the Laconian Gulf; its population and its military strength were by then enough for it to fight on its own account. Later Greeks still counted Corcyra among the oldest and richest of the colonies. On the Corinthian side the army was raised by the city of Corinth itself, and the state was governed by the Bacchiad family, a hereditary aristocracy that combined civic rule with the priesthood of the Delphic Apollo; the Bacchiads were also the driving force behind Corinthian colonisation, and Dyme was treated by Corinth as its own foothold on Euboea, so the mother city felt bound to protect the colony. Dyme had originally been an earlier settlement of the Chalcidian or Eretrian line on the island and only later came under Corinth, so the town was caught in a rivalry between two mother cities at once. The third party was Sparta: the Bacchiads of Corinth and the Agiads of Sparta were both Dorian and both descended from Heracles, and later tradition has it that Corinth appealed to Sparta over this affair; whether Sparta sent troops, and how many, cannot now be established. Neither side left us the name of a commander; decisions were taken by the assemblies and ruling houses of the two poleis, and the fighting force was a levy of hoplites drawn from the citizen body, supported by fast sailing vessels and penteconters.
people: 這場戰爭留下的人名極少，這本身就是它的特徵。修昔底德在《伯羅奔尼撒戰爭史》卷一開篇追述早期戰事時，只記下兩個城邦的名稱，沒有為任何一方點名指揮官。科爾基斯方面，執政的是島上世襲的赫拉克勒斯後裔家族；修昔底德談到它的姊妹城埃皮達姆諾斯時，說該城的奠基人是「赫拉克勒斯家族的埃拉托克萊德之子法拉伊俄斯」，可見科爾基斯這一支正出自同一血統，而科林斯本身同樣是赫拉克勒斯系的城邦，這層同源關係既是科林斯維護母邦權威的理由，也是科爾基斯拒絕受約束的底氣。科林斯方面，巴奇亞德家族掌握城政，並由家族成員擔任德爾斐阿波羅的祭司；這場戰爭之後不到十年，巴奇亞德政權被西普塞洛斯推翻，家族遭到清洗，許多族人帶著財產流亡他邦，科林斯此後進入僭主政治。斯巴達的亞基亞德諸王是科林斯最接近的同族親屬，傳統上把這場科林斯與科爾基斯的爭端說成科林斯向斯巴達求助、斯巴達以多利安人同族的身份介入；但相關細節只散見於後世詩人（例如科林斯人歐墨羅斯）的敘事，具體時序與出兵規模都已不可考。迪亞烏希方面唯一有記載的「人物」是城中成年男子：城破之後他們被集中起來賣為奴隸，婦孺與其餘居民則留在被獻給阿波羅的城中。編年方面，修昔底德在五世紀保存了這段記載，公元四世紀優西比烏斯的《編年史》與九世紀辛刻魯斯的《編年史綱要》把年份定在第八奧林匹克節，此後的希臘化時期編年史與近代研究才把它固定為公元前757年。
peopleEn: Very few names survive from this war, and that is itself one of its features. When Thucydides, at the opening of the first book of his History of the Peloponnesian War, looks back over the early wars of Greece, he names only the two poleis and points to no commander on either side. On the Corcyraean side the state was governed by a hereditary house descended from Heracles; speaking of the sister city of Epidamnus, Thucydides says that its founder was Phalius, son of Eratocleides, of the family of the Heraclids, so that the Corcyraean line issued from the same blood as the Bacchiad house of Corinth. That common descent was at once the ground on which Corinth maintained the authority of a mother city and the ground on which Corcyra refused to be ruled. On the Corinthian side the Bacchiads held the government, and members of the family served as priests of the Delphic Apollo; less than ten years after this war the Bacchiad government was overthrown by Cypselus, the clan was purged, and many of its members left Corinth with their wealth, which opened the way to tyranny there. The Agiad kings of Sparta were the closest kin of Corinth, and later tradition describes the quarrel between Corinth and Corcyra as one in which Corinth called on Sparta to intervene as a fellow Dorian. The details survive only in the verse of later poets such as Eumelus of Corinth, and the exact sequence of events and the size of any Spartan force are irrecoverable. The only people from Dyme with a recorded fate are the men of military age: when the city fell they were rounded up and sold as slaves, while the women, children and the rest of the population remained in a town that had been given over to Apollo. As for the chronology, Thucydides preserved the notice in the fifth century BC, and the date was fixed to the eighth Olympiad by Eusebius of Caesarea in his Chronicle in the fourth century AD and by Syncellus in the ninth; it was the Hellenistic chronographers and modern scholarship that settled it on 757 BC.
kits: 卡面這柄斯巴達長矛（dory）就是本場戰爭裡的基本兵器：一根約兩米長的白蠟木或榉木桿，前端裝柳葉形鐵矛頭，槍尾包銅套，握在手中是雙手推送的長刺兵器；槍尾的銅套讓它可以插在地上支撐身體，也方便在盾後調整重心。它在軍陣中的位置是「持矛手」的核心：兵員一手擎著小型圓盾（aspis），一手握矛，排成以盾牌互相掩護的隊列，矛尖越過盾緣指向前方，正是荷馬時代步兵的標準樣貌；早於公元前六世紀那種嚴整的密集方陣，這一時期的隊列仍帶有《伊利亞特》式的散開陣與單挑氣氛。與它配套的裝備包括：青銅或亞麻的胸甲、護脛、頭盔（八世紀盛行的前突式樣，尚未定型為後來的科林斯式）、短劍（xiphos）作隨身副武器，拋槍（akontia）配投槍索，以及弓箭——弓箭在荷馬式的戰鬥中仍大量使用。攻城方面沒有留下任何攻城塔或撞槌的記載；迪亞烏希是石築城垣的小型濱海城，攻城方式只能是強攻與封鎖海港兩種。運輸方面，科林斯的援軍先由陸路走到地峽海岸，再以五十槳長船與早期的雙列槳船轉運；科爾基斯控制的船隊同樣以長船為主力。值得注意的旁證是：修昔底德提到科林斯是最早採用新式造船的城邦，造船匠阿美諾克萊斯曾為薩摩斯人造了四艘船，時間在修昔底德所處時代之前不到三百年，約當公元前730年前後，說明這場戰爭的年代裡，兩邊的水上運輸能力已經相當成熟。城址至今未經系統發掘，迪亞烏希守軍的確切裝備組合無從逐一核實。
kitsEn: The dory on the card was the basic weapon of this war: a shaft of ash or beech about two metres long, fitted with a leaf-shaped iron head at the front and a bronze-shod butt at the rear, wielded in both hands as a long thrusting arm; the bronze shoe at the bottom let the spear be planted in the ground to support the body and made it easy to adjust balance behind the shield. Its place in the order of battle was at the core of the spearmen: a man carried a small round shield, the aspis, in one hand and the spear in the other, and the line was closed up so that shield covered shield, the spear points reaching out past the rim of the shields, which is the standard appearance of the infantryman of the Homeric age. Long before the disciplined deep phalanx of the sixth century BC, the formations of this period still carried the loose order and the air of single combat that belongs to the Iliad. The equipment worn with it included bronze or linen corselets, greaves, helmets of the forward-swept type fashionable in the eighth century and not yet settled into the later Corinthian form, the short sword, the xiphos, carried as a sidearm, javelins, the akontia, thrown with the aid of a thong, and bows and arrows, for archery still filled a large place in Homeric fighting. Nothing is recorded about siege towers or battering rams; Dyme was a small coastal town with stone-built walls, and the two available ways of taking it were assault by storm and the sealing of its harbour. On the logistics side, the Corinthian relief force moved by land to the coast of the isthmus and was then carried across the water in penteconters and early two-banked galleys; the Corcyraean fleet was built on the same long vessels. One useful side witness is Thucydides' remark that Corinth was the first city to take up the new style of shipbuilding, and that the shipwright Ameinocles built four ships for the Samians a little less than three hundred years before his own time, that is around 730 BC, which shows how well developed the sea transport of both sides already was in the decade of this war. The site has never been systematically excavated, so the exact equipment combination of the Dymean garrison cannot be checked item by item.
tactics: 從留下來的記載看，這場戰爭的樣式接近一次以海軍實力為骨架的殖民攻勢。科爾基斯一方必須先渡過愛奧尼亞海：科爾基斯到迪亞烏希的直線距離約三百七十公里，實際航程要繞行島嶼與海峽，還要提防科林斯在科爾基斯海峽一線的舟師攔截，因此這不是一次臨時起意的越海襲擊，而是有備而來的遠征，須選在順風的航季，登陆的地點也必須選在守方舟師夠不到的岸段。登陸之後，步兵以盾牆式散開隊列推進：八世紀的重裝步兵尚未定型為五世紀那種互相扶肩的深陣，但盾與矛的配合已足以把城牆上的散兵壓退；對付這種石牆小城，強攻的成功與否取決於速度，取決於能不能在科林斯的援軍登岸之前把城門打開。科林斯一方的行動在地理上很吃虧：從科林斯到迪亞烏希，直線距離只有五十公里上下，但海路要先穿過科林斯灣、繞過日拉尼翁角再北上厄維亞灣，航程約二百至二百五十公里，沿途還要經過科林斯視為自家勢力範圍的內陸，實際走陸路反而要從島的中部穿行約一百多公里。修昔底德只記「科林斯派出一支軍隊」，既沒有說這支部隊是否在野外交手，也沒有說它是否趕得及登岸；比較合理的推測是援軍被拖延或牽制，迪亞烏希因此陷落。城破之後的處置同樣是作戰的一部分：城中的成年男子被集中起來賣為奴隸，其餘城地連同房屋被獻給阿波羅，等於以神的名義取消這座城的城邦資格與一切產權，讓任何一方都無法再以「母邦」的名義主張它。希臘式的攻城季一般落在春末到秋初，本戰役的確切月份沒有記載。
tacticsEn: From what survives, this war looks like a colonial offensive built on a framework of sea power. The Corcyraeans first had to cross the Ionian Sea: the direct distance from Corcyra to Dyme is about 370 kilometres, the actual passage had to work round islands and straits, and they had to fear Corinthian squadrons intercepting them in the Corcyrean channel. It was therefore not a sudden raid across the water but a prepared expedition, which had to be timed to the sailing season and to a stretch of coast the enemy's galleys could not reach. After landing, the infantry advanced in a loose line closed by their shields: the hoplites of the eighth century had not yet hardened into the deep, shoulder-linked phalanx of the fifth century, but the combination of shield and spear was already enough to push the scattered defenders off the wall. Against a small stone-walled town like this, the success of an assault turned on speed, on getting the gate open before the Corinthian relief could put its men ashore. The Corinthian side was at a serious geographical disadvantage: from Corinth to Dyme the direct distance is only about fifty kilometres, but the sea route runs first through the Gulf of Corinth, round the cape of Geraneus and then north up the Euboean Gulf, some two hundred to two hundred and fifty kilometres, passing through what Corinth regarded as its own sphere of interest, while the land route across the middle of the island is over a hundred kilometres. Thucydides records only that Corinth sent out an army; he says neither whether that army fought a field action nor whether it arrived in time to land, and the likeliest reconstruction is that the relief was delayed or held off, so that Dyme fell. The treatment of the town after the capture was likewise part of the operation: the men of military age were rounded up and sold into slavery, and the rest of the city, with its buildings, was dedicated to Apollo, which in effect cancelled the town's civic status and all property rights in the name of a god, so that neither side could afterwards claim the place as a mother city might. The Greek campaigning season generally ran from late spring into early autumn, and no month is recorded for this operation.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。年份本身不是修昔底德給的：他把這場戰爭記在卷一開篇追述早期戰事之處，現代學者一般引作卷一第十三節一帶；定年來自後世編年史，優西比烏斯的《編年史》「奧林匹克表」與辛刻魯斯的《編年史綱要》把科爾基斯攻取迪亞烏希列在第八奧林匹克節，即公元前757／756年，近代研究多取公元前757年。月份沒有任何史料記載，卡面取七月，根據是希臘世界的征戰多在春末至秋初，艦隊遠征更須順季風。一個可以換算的旁證是修昔底德的相對年代：他說科林斯人與科爾基斯人的第一次海戰在他所處時代之前約二百六十年，按他的系年折算約在公元前690年前後；又說科林斯造船匠阿美諾克萊斯為薩摩斯人造四艘船是在不到三百年前，約公元前730年前後。距離方面，科爾基斯到迪亞烏希直線約三百七十公里，科林斯到迪亞烏希直線約五十公里、海路約二百至二百五十公里，迪亞烏希沿島陸路到卡爾基斯約一百二十公里。兵力數字則完全沒有留下：科爾基斯的出征部隊規模不明，但必須大到足以攻下一座城、並在海上切斷科林斯對迪亞烏希的補給；科林斯援軍的人數與船數同樣不詳；迪亞烏希被賣為奴隸的成年男子人數也沒有記載，只能從「其餘城地獻予阿波羅」推知這是一個規模不大的小城。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The date is not Thucydides' own: he puts the war in the survey of early Greek history at the opening of his first book, modern scholars generally citing it in the region of 1.13; the dating comes from the later chronographers, for the Olympiad table of Eusebius' Chronicle and the epitome of Syncellus both place the Corcyraean capture of Dyme in the eighth Olympiad, that is 757/756 BC, and modern work generally takes 757 BC. No month is recorded anywhere; the card gives July, on the ground that Greek campaigning fell mainly between late spring and early autumn and a fleet expedition had to fit the sailing season. One convertible piece of evidence is Thucydides' relative dating: he says the first sea-fight between the Corinthians and the Corcyraeans came about two hundred and sixty years before his own time, which on his system works out to around 690 BC; and that the Corinthian shipwright Ameinocles built four ships for the Samians less than three hundred years before, around 730 BC. As for distances, the direct line from Corcyra to Dyme is about 370 kilometres, from Corinth to Dyme about fifty kilometres by the straight line and about two hundred to two hundred and fifty kilometres by sea, and about 120 kilometres from Dyme along the island to Chalcis. No figures for the numbers of men are preserved at all: the size of the Corcyraean expedition is unknown, though it must have been large enough to take a walled town and to cut Corinth's supply to Dyme by sea; the number of Corinthian men and ships is equally unknown; and no number survives for the men of Dyme sold into slavery, from the fact that the rest of the town was given to Apollo one can only infer that this was a town of modest size.
cause: 修昔底德把直接起因講得很直白：科林斯人在與科爾基斯開戰的同時，派兵去救援迪亞烏希的居民——這些居民是科林斯人在厄維亞島的殖民地，當時正面臨被科爾基斯人征服的命運。換句話說，這不是兩國為新土地而起的領土之爭，而是一個已經長大、並且不再聽話的殖民地，向母邦的權利提出了挑戰。背景是八世紀希臘世界的一個大轉折：航海與殖民同時推高各城邦的實力，海外貿易的利潤讓科爾基斯這種島嶼城邦迅速富庶；科爾基斯扼住由希臘本土通往義大利、西西里的航路，又受惠於島上土地與海盆的物產，財力足以養出獨立的艦隊與重裝步兵。科爾基斯的世襲統治家族出自赫拉克勒斯系，與科林斯同源，這讓它有資格主張自己不是科林斯的屬地，而是與科林斯平起平坐的同族城邦。科林斯方面的理由則是母邦的權利：殖民地被視為母邦的延伸，母邦有義務救援，而科林斯的巴奇亞德家族正是德爾斐阿波羅的祭司家族，信仰與祭司的權柄同樣被搬出來作為主張的依據。從更大範圍看，這場戰爭是八世紀「殖民」體制的一次失敗實驗：所謂殖民關係原本是一套儀式性、法律性的義務，一旦殖民地強大到可以單獨作戰，這套義務便形同虛設，而科林斯用兵也未能挽回。
causeEn: Thucydides states the immediate cause quite plainly: at the very time the Corinthians were at war with the Corcyraeans they dispatched troops to the aid of the people of Dyme, who were the Corinthians' colonists on Euboea and were then in danger of being conquered by the Corcyraeans. In other words, this was not a territorial scramble between two states over new land; it was a colony that had grown up and would no longer take orders, challenging the claims of its mother city. The background is one of the great turning points of the eighth-century Greek world: navigation and colonisation raised the strength of every polis at once, and the profits of overseas trade made island poleis such as Corcyra rich very quickly. Corcyra commanded the sea route from the Greek mainland towards Italy and Sicily and drew further resources from the island's own land and from the produce of its gulfs, giving it the wealth to maintain an independent fleet and a levy of hoplites. Its hereditary ruling house came from the line of Heracles and was of the same stock as Corinth, which entitled it to claim that it was not a possession of Corinth but a kindred polis on equal terms. The Corinthian case was the claim of the mother city: a colony was treated as an extension of the metropolis, and the metropolis was bound to protect it, while the Bacchiad house at Corinth was the priestly family of the Delphic Apollo, so that religion and the authority of the priesthood were brought out to support the claim. On a larger scale, the war was a failed experiment in the colonial system of the eighth century. The colonial relationship had been a body of ritual and legal obligation, and once a colony grew strong enough to fight on its own account those obligations became empty words; the force Corinth sent out could not save them.
impact: 迪亞烏希的命運是這場戰爭最直接的後果。城破之後，成年男子被賣為奴隸，其餘城地獻給阿波羅，這座存在於《伊利亞特》「船舶目錄」裡的古老城邦就此實質上被抹去：城牆還在，人卻散去，厄維亞島南部的城邑格局從此重組，海濱的居民與耕地改由埃雷特里亞與卡爾基斯一系重新整合；直至今日，島南仍有上迪米一村的古名留傳，可見這次徵用的痕跡。科爾基斯則完成了對母邦的最後切割：它不再向科林斯納貢、不再派代表參加母邦的競技會，而是以一個獨立的海上城邦姿態存在。數百年後的公元前433年，科爾基斯在埃皮達姆諾斯問題上與科林斯再啟戰端，走投無路時向雅典求援，最後與雅典結盟，開啟了科爾基斯戰爭，也把雅典一步步推向伯羅奔尼撒戰爭。回頭看，公元前433年那場戰爭的辯詞，正是從公元前757年這場被遺忘的戰爭接續下來的：母邦的權利、殖民地的「自治」、德爾斐的仲裁、以及用神的名義取消對方的產權，這四樣在這場戰爭裡都已出現過一次，而它們在五世紀被重新拿起來時，殺傷的規模已經大得多。對斯巴達而言，這場戰爭也可能是它以多利安人仲裁者身份介入希臘事務的一次早期演練，日後斯巴達在希臘世界扮演的角色，雛形正是在這些同族糾紛裡形成的。
impactEn: The fate of Dyme is the most direct consequence of the war. After the fall of the city the men of military age were sold as slaves and the rest of the place was given over to Apollo, and this old polis, named in the Catalogue of Ships of the Iliad, was thereby effectively erased: the walls remained but the people scattered, and the pattern of settlement in southern Euboea was reorganised, with the coastal population and farmland reabsorbed by the Eretrian and Chalcidian lines. To this day the old name survives in the village of Upper Dymi in the south of the island, a trace of that conscription. Corcyra, for its part, completed the last severing from its mother city: it no longer paid tribute to Corinth and no longer sent delegations to the mother city's games, but existed as an independent maritime polis. In 433 BC, some three centuries later, Corcyra went to war with Corinth again over Epidamnus, found itself with no allies, turned to Athens for help and finally concluded an alliance with Athens, which opened the Corcyraean War and pushed Athens step by step towards the Peloponnesian War. Read backwards, the arguments of 433 BC continue directly from this forgotten war of 757 BC: the rights of the mother city, the autonomy of the colony, the arbitration of Delphi, and the cancellation of the other party's property in the name of a god had all already appeared once here, and when they were taken up again in the fifth century the scale of killing was a great deal larger. For Sparta the war was also, perhaps, an early exercise in intervening in Greek affairs as an arbiter among Dorians; the role Sparta was later to play in the Greek world took shape in quarrels of this kind between kindred communities.
result: 結果是明確的：科爾基斯攻下了迪亞烏希。修昔底德的記載在這裡沒有留下任何含糊，他的原話是，科爾基斯人攻下城後，把迪亞烏希的成年男子賣為奴隸，其餘的城則獻給阿波羅；這表示科林斯的援軍沒有守住殖民地，也沒有把這場戰爭扳成平手，母邦第一次在海外殖民地身上失了手。迪亞烏希此後在史料中不再以科林斯殖民地的身份出現，城址逐步荒廢，島南的居民分布重組；而科林斯被迫吞下這口氣，把爭端記在帳上。長期看，這場戰爭並沒有解決任何根本問題：科爾基斯擺脫了科林斯的管束，卻也從此沒有真正的盟友，孤立無援的處境正是它在公元前433年走向雅典的原因。科林斯則把母邦的尊嚴看得越來越重，直到公元前433年為埃皮達姆諾斯出兵，終於在敘巴塔外海與科爾基斯正面交鋒，以慘敗收場。兩場戰爭相隔三百二十四年，中間隔著科爾基斯艦隊從數十艘長船成長為可與雅典結盟的海上強權的過程，也隔著希臘各城邦從部落聯盟走向城邦國家的制度變化。回頭看，公元前757年這場沒有留下兵力數字、沒有留下指揮官姓名、甚至連月份都不詳的小戰役，反而是理解希臘海外殖民關係如何崩解的第一份證據。
resultEn: The outcome is not in doubt: Corcyra took Dyme. Thucydides' account leaves nothing vague here; his words are that when the Corcyraeans had taken the town they sold the men of military age among the Dymeans as slaves and dedicated the rest of the city to Apollo. The Corinthian relief failed to hold the colony, and the war could not be turned into a draw; for the first time the mother city lost the company of a colony overseas. Dyme no longer appears in the historical record as a Corinthian colony, the site was gradually abandoned, and the distribution of population in the south of the island was rearranged, while Corinth was forced to swallow the grievance and keep the account. In the long run the war settled nothing fundamental. Corcyra had escaped the tutelage of Corinth but was left without a real ally, and that position of isolation is exactly what drove it to Athens in 433 BC. Corinth, for its part, grew ever more attached to the dignity of the mother city, until in 433 BC it sent out an army for Epidamnus and finally met Corcyra in a set-piece naval battle off Sybota, where it was badly beaten. The two wars are three hundred and twenty-four years apart, and between them lies the growth of the Corcyraean fleet from a few dozen long vessels into a maritime power able to ally with Athens, and the institutional transformation of the Greek poleis from tribal leagues into city-states. Looked at from the end, this little war of 757 BC, which left no figures for the numbers of men, no names of commanders and not even a month, is nevertheless the first piece of evidence for how the Greek overseas colonial relationship came apart.
